fields.description: central: this site stores events, evaluates rules and opens incidents. satellite: this site only captures its local signals and forwards them to a central Wolf site.
fields.label: Mode

fields.description: Set by Register with central site.
fields.label: Central URL

fields.description: Wolf Agent name of this site on the central site.
fields.label: Satellite ID

fields.description: Last successful push to the central site.
fields.label: Last Forward At

fields.description: Shared secret that `wolf-agent register --token` must present. Leave empty to disable new registrations.
fields.label: Registration Token

fields.description: Seconds between agent pushes (sent back to agents).
fields.label: Push Interval

fields.description: Raise a warning event when an agent has not pushed for this long.
fields.label: Agent Silence Minutes

fields.description: Timestamps further in the future than this are clamped to the server time on ingest. 0 disables.
fields.label: Max Clock Skew (seconds)

fields.description: Per agent (and satellite). Pushes over the limit get HTTP 429 and the agent retries with backoff. 0 turns the limit off.
fields.label: Max Pushes Per Minute

fields.description: async: a push is validated, queued on the short queue and stored by a worker (inline when the queue is unreachable). sync: stored during the request.
fields.label: Ingest Mode

fields.description: Deployments this recent are linked to new incidents.
fields.label: Deployment Window Minutes

fields.description: Events this long before an incident started are shown in its timeline.
fields.label: Timeline Padding Minutes
Flag privileged logins from new IPs

fields.description: One role per line.
fields.label: Privileged Roles

fields.description: Server and Client Scripts that can run new code, System Console runs, permission rule and Role Profile changes, weakened System Settings (2FA, password policy, lockout, sessions), API keys generated and Webhooks to a new host.
fields.label: Flag risky application changes

fields.description: Report exports, Data Export, bulk PDFs and list reads, counted per user and hour. An event when a user's hour is far above their largest hour of the last 14 days (critical at 20x, or without any history), once past the floor below.
fields.label: Flag unusual data exports

fields.description: Below this volume in an hour (MB of responses), nothing is compared.
fields.label: Export Floor (MB per hour)

fields.description: Warning when a user's hour is this many times their largest hour of the last 14 days.
fields.label: Export Factor
Email queue and login geography (this site)

fields.description: Every 5 minutes: an event while emails wait in the Email Queue longer than the limit below, and while sending errors keep appearing.
fields.label: Watch the Email Queue

fields.description: Not Sent / Sending emails older than this (and due) count as a backlog.
fields.label: Email Queue Stale Minutes

fields.description: With a GeoIP database below: flag privileged logins from a country none of the user's earlier logins came from.
fields.label: Flag privileged logins from new countries

fields.description: Path to an offline database on this server: a MaxMind-format .mmdb (GeoLite2-Country, DB-IP Lite, IPinfo Lite) or a CSV of start_ip,end_ip,country ranges. Relative paths are read from the site directory. No online lookup is ever made.
fields.label: GeoIP Database

fields.description: Download the lists below once a day and tag security events whose IP is on one (one severity step more). Only the lists are downloaded; nothing is sent.
fields.label: Use IP reputation lists

fields.description: One list per line: a name, then a URL or a file path (relative to the site). One address or CIDR per line in each list.
fields.label: IP reputation lists

fields.description: Download the Frappe and ERPNext security advisories from GitHub once a day and compare them with the versions the agents report (Security posture). An unauthenticated read of public data: nothing about this installation is sent.
fields.label: Check versions against GitHub Security Advisories

fields.description: Decoy accounts nobody uses (one email per line): any login attempt on them is critical.
fields.label: Decoy users

fields.description: Decoy API keys (one per line), e.g. left in an old backup or a repository: any request using one is critical. Do not create them on a real user.
fields.label: Decoy API keys

fields.description: Paths linked from nowhere (one per line, e.g. /app/backup-admin): any request for one is critical.
fields.label: Decoy paths
SIEM export (syslog)
fields.description: Send security events, and the journal, to UniSOC, Wazuh, Graylog or any syslog collector: RFC 5424 carrying CEF or OCSF JSON.
TCP and TLS use octet-counted frames (RFC 6587). UDP may drop or cut messages.
fields.label: Transport

fields.description: Comma-separated: security, error, cron_failure, worker_failure, host_metric_alert, deployment.
fields.label: Event types

fields.description: Also send every signed journal entry (seq, digest, mac): an external copy of the chain.
fields.label: Send the journal

fields.description: Raw metric samples are kept this long, then only their 1-minute and 1-hour rollups. Samples not rolled up yet are never purged.
fields.label: Raw Metric Retention (hours)

fields.description: 1-minute rollups (charts up to 2 days, long rule windows).
fields.label: 1-Minute Rollup Retention (days)

fields.description: 1-hour rollups (7-day charts and longer).
fields.label: 1-Hour Rollup Retention (days)

fields.description: Tamper-evident journal entries older than this are removed every night, after a signed purge record that verification checks. 0 keeps them forever. Entries the SIEM export has not sent yet are kept.
fields.label: Journal Retention Days

fields.description: Base URL used in alert links. Defaults to this site's URL.
fields.label: Public Url

fields.description: Acknowledge/resolve links in alerts stay valid this long. 0 disables them.
fields.label: Action Link Hours
